config.hide_warnings: Skipping validation|sf package install|Warning: Record types|org-capitalize-record-types

scripts.source:sync: ((npm run source:diff:push | grep 'Will') && npm run source:push || echo 'Nothing To Deploy\n') && ((npm run source:diff:pull | grep 'Will') && npm run source:pull || echo 'Nothing To Retrieve')
scripts.source:sync:force: ((npm run source:diff:push | grep 'Conflicts') && npm run source:push:force || echo 'No Deploy Conflicts\n') && ((npm run source:diff:pull | grep 'Conflicts') && npm run source:pull:force || echo 'No Retrieve Conflicts')
scripts.test: npm run test:lwc && npm run test:apex
scripts.package:build: dotenv -- sf package version create --package $npm_package_config_package_name --code-coverage --installation-key-bypass --wait $npm_package_config_wait 2>&1 | grep -vE "$npm_package_config_hide_warnings" && git add sfdx-project.json && git commit -m 'chore: release package version' && git tag -a "v$npm_package_version" -m "Release v$npm_package_version" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.package:build:beta: dotenv -- sf package version create --package $npm_package_config_package_name --skip-validation --installation-key-bypass --wait $npm_package_config_wait 2>&1 | grep -vE "$npm_package_config_hide_warnings" && git add sfdx-project.json && git commit -m 'chore: release package version (beta)'
scripts.package:build:patch: npm run package:bump:patch && npm run package:build
scripts.package:build:minor: npm run package:bump:minor && npm run package:build
scripts.package:build:major: npm run package:bump:major && npm run package:build
scripts.package:promote: dotenv -- sf package version promote --package "$(sf package version list --json | jq -r $npm_package_config_jq_version)" --no-prompt
scripts.package:install:beta: npm run package:build:beta && npm run package:install:qa:wait
scripts.package:install:qa: dotenv -- sf package install --package "$(sf package version list --json | jq -r $npm_package_config_jq_version)" --target-org "${QA_ALIAS:-$npm_package_config_qa_alias}" --no-prompt
scripts.package:install:uat: dotenv -- sf package install --package "$(sf package version list --json | jq -r $npm_package_config_jq_version)" --target-org "${UAT_ALIAS:-$npm_package_config_uat_alias}" --wait $npm_package_config_wait --publish-wait $npm_package_config_wait --no-prompt
scripts.package:install:prod: dotenv -- sf package install --package "$(sf package version list --json | jq -r $npm_package_config_jq_version)" --target-org "${PROD_ALIAS:-$npm_package_config_prod_alias}" --wait $npm_package_config_wait --publish-wait $npm_package_config_wait --no-prompt
scripts.package:install:all: npm run package:install:qa ; npm run package:install:uat ; npm run package:install:prod
scripts.package:deploy:beta: npm run package:bump:patch && npm run package:install:beta
scripts.package:deploy:patch: npm run package:build:patch && npm run package:promote && npm run package:install:all
scripts.package:deploy:minor: npm run package:build:minor && npm run package:promote && npm run package:install:all
scripts.package:deploy:major: npm run package:build:major && npm run package:promote && npm run package:install:all
scripts.package:deploy: ((npm run package:build:patch && npm run package:promote) || (npm run package:build:minor && npm run package:promote)) && npm run package:install:all
scripts.ci:package:promote: sf package version promote --package "$(sf package version list --json | jq -r $npm_package_config_jq_version)" --no-prompt
scripts.org:create: npm run org:delete; dotenv -- sf org create scratch --definition-file config/project-scratch-def.json --alias "${TARGET_ALIAS:-$npm_package_config_dev_alias}" --duration-days 30 --set-default && npm run org:init && npm run org:open
scripts.org:init: npm run source:push && npm run access:assign:all && npm run debug:toggle && npm run data:import
scripts.debug:toggle: dotenv -- sf apex run --file scripts/apex/toggleDebugMode.apex | grep -iE 'USER_DEBUG|FAIL|SUCCESS'
scripts.access:assign:all: npm run access:assign:user && npm run access:assign:admin
scripts.update:latest:apply: dotenv -- npx npm-check-updates -u && dotenv -- npm install
scripts.git:commit: git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: update all'
scripts.org:config:log:schedule: dotenv -- sf apex run --file scripts/apex/scheduleLogCleanup.apex | grep -iE 'USER_DEBUG|FAIL|SUCCESS'
scripts.org:config:log:schedule:qa: dotenv -- sf apex run --file scripts/apex/scheduleLogCleanup.apex --target-org "${QA_ALIAS:-$npm_package_config_qa_alias}" | grep -iE 'USER_DEBUG|FAIL|SUCCESS'
scripts.org:config:log:schedule:uat: dotenv -- sf apex run --file scripts/apex/scheduleLogCleanup.apex --target-org "${UAT_ALIAS:-$npm_package_config_uat_alias}" | grep -iE 'USER_DEBUG|FAIL|SUCCESS'
scripts.org:config:log:schedule:prod: dotenv -- sf apex run --file scripts/apex/scheduleLogCleanup.apex --target-org "${PROD_ALIAS:-$npm_package_config_prod_alias}" | grep -iE 'USER_DEBUG|FAIL|SUCCESS'
scripts.source:diff: sf project deploy preview && sf project retrieve preview
scripts.sync:update: git submodule update --remote --recursive . && node .template/sync.js && npm install
